extension_policy.purpose: Reusable, explicit classification decisions for already-approved source classes (RECONCILIATION.md section B). A policy only ever *reuses* a decision an owner already made -- it never grants a new one.
extension_policy.matching: path_patterns are glob patterns (fnmatch semantics) matched against the full repo-relative path. No substring/keyword matching against arbitrary path text is permitted here -- that is exactly the failure mode this registry exists to replace.
extension_policy.eligible_target: a decision.*/layer.* node id this policy's matches are attributed to for traceability. Not required to already exist as a loaded catalog node -- a policy MAY be added in the same PR as, or before, the node it references.
